answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 41975 Country: India Title: I want to ask you that can we wear leather socks during Ihram in Hajj or Umrah and perform Tawaf, Sai, etc. wearing leather socks. Question: I want to ask you that can we wear leather socks during Ihram in Hajj or Umrah and perform Tawaf, Sai, etc. wearing leather socks. Answer ID: 41975 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1041/1028/N=1433) (1 & 2) Men cannot wear any kinds of socks in the state of Ihram in tawaf, sa’i and in any other time when they are in ihram. It is forbidden for males to wear socks in the state of Ihram. Yes, there is no harm in wearing the socks while doing tawaf when a man is not in ihram. In the same way if a man cuts the socks at the place of ankle and they look like slippers then there is no harm in wearing such types of socks in the state of Ihram. قال فى الدر (مع الرد كتاب الحج 3: 495، 498-500 ط مكتبة زكريا ديوبند): وبعده أي : الإحرام بلا مهلة يتقي ..........لبس .......خفين إلا أن لا يجد نعلين فيقطعهما أسفل من الكعبين عند معقد الشراك فيجوز لبس السرموزة لا الجوربين اهـ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
